Then, I'll apply this to look at prevalence rates of autoimmune diseases. I have no clue what she means. Can you first help explain what she might mean? I don't know examples of what Electronic Health Records look like. What NLP techniques might I be using on data like this? What subgroups in CDC WONDER data would I be abstracting? How could I apply this to look at prevalence rates of autoimmune diseases? What skills should I brush up on? Please help me create a plan for my research going forward, according to what the professor said.
